mapper.select: SELECT record_date AS recordDate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS receivedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingAmount FROM side_income_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND record_date >= #{startDate} AND record_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY record_date ORDER BY record_date ASC
